title: AI usage
description: Cross-fabric AI usage rollup: tokens/cost per day by agent/tier/model/device, local serving throughput, router error/fallback rates, Claude Code cache economics, Codex/Hermes activity, and Langfuse trace volume. Sourced from claude-code-metrics/cache-economics/subagents-tools (this repo) plus the LiteLLM router's own Prometheus metrics. Panels using litellm_* metric names are UNVERIFIED against a live proxy as of authoring — see docs/AI_OBSERVABILITY.md for the verification note before treating this as demo-ready.

panels.title: Cost by day (Claude Code JSONL ETL)
panels.description: Daily USD, summed across every repo the ETL attributes a session to. Codex/Hermes cost is not yet in this series — see 'Codex turns' and 'Hermes calls' panels for their own activity counters until a comparable cost figure is derived for them.

panels.title: Cost by tier (local vs subscription)
panels.description: Requires the router's litellm_spend_metric_total to expose metadata.tier as a label. Router callback settings (60-ops.yml) confirmed enabled this pass; the exact label set exposed by this deployment's LiteLLM version is UNVERIFIED — CIDR-blocked from a live query. If the label is absent, this panel needs metadata.tier promoted via a Prometheus relabel in the callback, not a new exporter.

panels.title: Local tok/s per backend
panels.description: mlx-served throughput per model, sourced from the local-serving stack's own gauge. Metric name matches this estate's mlx-preflight/serving convention (mlx_serving_tokens_per_second) — UNVERIFIED live this pass.

panels.title: Langfuse traces (24h)
panels.description: Langfuse's own metrics are not scraped by this stack today — this panel is a placeholder pending either a Langfuse Prometheus exporter or a periodic ETL push of its trace-count API into VictoriaMetrics (langfuse_traces_total). Do not ship this panel as-is if it renders 'No data' at demo time; pull the count from the Langfuse API directly instead until the metric exists.

panels.title: Daily tokens by tier and billing class
panels.description: Daily counter increases from Claude Code, Codex and LiteLLM. Claude is filtered by enduser_id; Codex is global under auth_mode=Chatgpt because no operator identity label is present. Subscription tiers map by model. LiteLLM tier and billing class come from registry-backed tags; provider is api_provider. Input excludes cached_input and cache_write_input where those are subsets, then cacheRead and cacheWrite appear as separate token types. reasoning_output is already included in output. Missing series are gaps, not zero.
